title: S215 Furniture Installation Labor Storage - Base Plus Four Option Years
description: Sources-sought market research for the Southern Arizona VA Health Care System (Tucson): furniture pickup, storage, installation and electronic inventory services under a single-award IDIQ, with a contractor warehouse of about 6,000 square feet within fifty miles of the Tucson medical center, web-based inventory, and installers certified for Herman Miller, Steelcase, Knoll, Haworth and Allsteel. Total small business set-aside; the VA says it must first consider an SDVOSB set-aside. Size standard $36.5M for NAICS 493190.
